title: ActionRunner: an `operation: 'update'` action posts its declared `patch` as wire `params`, so the runtime cannot refuse undeclared params without breaking every declarative-update button (objectstack#24268 paired half)
body:
**Filing gate ④, the paired half of a cross-repo contract fix.** Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) while grading objectstack-ai/objectstack#24268. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Pull:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#24268 (p1, `target:v18`). An `operation: 'update'` action with no declared `params` writes any wire key into the row, measured on `18.0.0-next.3` by the objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2128 dev. The runtime half refuses an undeclared param (ADR-0104 D2). It cannot land first, because this console posts the action's own `patch` keys as `params` (measured request body `{"recordId":…,"params":{"status":"completed"}}`), and every declarative-update button would then be refused.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` seat, in `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`.

## Measured (objectui `origin/main`)

- `ActionRunner.executeUpdateOperation` (`:1760`) collects `action.params` and `action.patch` and sends the patch keys on the wire as `params`.
- The declared `patch` is the server's: `declarativeUpdateWrite` (objectstack `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2191`) applies it from the action definition, not from the wire.

## Done when

- An `operation: 'update'` action posts only its declared `params`: the values the user supplied for declared params. ⛔ It never posts the `patch` keys; the server applies them.
- Every declarative-update button still writes its patch, pinned against a server that refuses undeclared params, with a control for an action that declares a param.
- `Clause-②: no`: no key moves, only what the runner sends.

## Order

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24268 is `pm:blocked` on this card and on objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carrying it, so the runtime refusal never lands ahead of the console that would trip it.

## Dedupe

objectui issues enumerated over REST right after filing (the 1000 most recently updated items: 489 issues, #2763–#12941, control objectui#12870 found), grepped for `executeUpdateOperation`, "declarative update" and "patch … as … params": 1 hit, this card itself. The runtime half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#24268. (This paragraph was corrected in place: the first version claimed the read before it had run.)
